description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1941): GAMMA's large-x composition. Rows 1-16384 are 64 runs of 256 consecutive doubles from x0 = 8.0731 + 2.5803*j; rows 16385-16416 are single cells at candidate piece cuts (7.9 ... 90). D = GAMMA, E = POWER(x*x,(x-0.5)/2), F = POWER(x,x-0.5), G = EXP(-x), H = EXP(x), I = POWER(x,(x-0.5)/2), J = x*x.
